headline: Improving stock market operations: conditions and roadmap
summary: Vietnam's stock market regulator is studying adjustments to trading time and methods to increase efficiency. The changes aim to make trading more convenient for investors.
why: Trading hours and market mechanisms determine how and when investors can execute orders. Changes can affect liquidity and market access for both domestic and foreign investors.
